fork_fee_mechanism_active.meaning: the forked pair uses the modified reserve-shaving fee mechanism inside _update instead of charging standard swap fees from input

identical_swap_on_both.meaning: an identical swap is performed on both the forked pair and the reference Uniswap-like pair

fork_reserves_after.meaning: combined reserve product (x*y) of the forked pair after the identical swap

fork_reserves_before.meaning: combined reserve product (x*y) of the forked pair before the identical swap, as established by the fee mechanism precondition

reference_reserves_after.meaning: combined reserve product (x*y) of the reference pair after the identical swap

assumptions: The reference pair implements standard Uniswap V2 fee behavior, so its post-swap reserve product can serve as the fair comparison baseline.
The identical swap is executed under otherwise equal conditions on both pairs.
The fork's reserve-shaving mechanism is the only material difference from the reference pair.

unresolved.description: No numeric reserve amounts, swap amounts, or LP portfolio values are given; the conservation relation must be bound to symbolic before/after reserve products rather than concrete values.

The report compares LP portfolio value in the fork versus a reference pair but provides no numeric baseline or formula for the expected/fair post-swap reserve product, so a direct state_correspondence equality with a reference quantity cannot be grounded.

limitations: Only the i_lp_portfolio_drop impact is formalized as the single direct impact for this core claim; i_value_leak, i_fee_erosion, and i_arb_extract are deferred to future claims.
The core observable symbols cite the intent and selected impact where the report jointly defines the conservation relevance, but concrete token units and magnitudes are not report-grounded.

The precedence of p_trader_swap, p_arb_backrun and a_swap_execute is not formalized because those facts are contextual to the described scenario and not the selected conservation relation's before-state.
The report's 'risk free' arbitrage characterization and any on-chain realization are noted but not part of this single relation's safety formula.
